verdicts.rationale: An empty requiredEvidence list performs no category checks and accepts evidence {}, allowing a passing unevidenced timeout.
safe_path permits any resolved target under the run directory, so an inputs symlink to contract.md satisfies both path and hash checks.
The portable package does not restrict hosts to SHA-1 repositories, while the 40-character-only expression rejects full 64-character Git SHA-256 object IDs.
Three evidence categories reference inputs/pit-audit.md but the example inputs map contains only inputs/contract-source.md, so the shown manifest fails evidence hashing.
